provenance.reference: af06299 initial public release; migrated from tests/manifest.json and tests/test_detector.py at a8c6ee2
provenance.origin: Frame at 20.1 s of a user screen recording in which a later garage frame was once counted as a second WIN (the v19 precision regression); this garage frame is the one that was counted.

truth.basis: The implementer viewed the full ROI: it shows the garage with a cyan AC model filling the band. The checked frame class is the legacy expectation from tests/manifest.json.

privacy.notes: The implementer inspected the full ROI at 2x. No player or opponent name, Steam identifier, notification, third-party overlay, desktop, local path, token or secret is visible, and the PPM header carries no comment field. A 'RYZEN' logo is visible in the garage scene; it is a brand mark, not personal data.

redistribution.notes: Committed by the repository owner in the initial public release (af06299, 2026-08-30) and public since. It contains ARMORED CORE VI game imagery; this records where the asset came from, not a licence determination.
